m: ममाथ n. N. of a Sāman (v.l. for माथात).

s: puM, (mavyati baDnAti janAniti । mavya banDane + “mavyateryalopo maScApatuw cAlaH .” uRA॰ 5 । 50 । iti AlapratyayaH । DAtoryalopaH makAraScAntasya pratyayasyApatuqAgamaSca .) vizayaH । iti sidDAntakOmudyAmuRAdivfttiH ॥
v: pu॰ maba Alan DAtorbasya maH apatugAgamaSca । vizaye si॰ kO॰
m: ममापताल (?) m. an object of sense (= विषय), Uṇ. v, 50, Sch.
ममाय Nom. Ā. ˚यते, to envy (with acc.), MBh.

s: vya, madIyam । AmAra iti BAzA । yaTA, “mamatvaM mama rAjyasya rAjyANgezvaKilezvapi । jAnato'pi yaTAjYasya kimetanmunisattama ! ॥” iti mArkaRqeyapurARe devImAhAtmyam ॥ “tezu amadIyatvaM jAnato'pi mama yaTAjYasya ajYasyeva rAjyAdizu mamatvametat ki kiM nibanDanamityarTaH .” iti tawwIkAyAM nAgojIBawwaH ॥ asyAvyayatvena spazwapramARaM mamatvaSabde drazwavyam । asmacCabdasya zazWyekavacanAntasyedaM rUpaM tatpadaM trizu liNgezu sadfSam ॥
v: avya॰ BA--bA॰ qama । zazWyarTavftteH asmacCasyArTe tena mamatvamiti mamateti ca siDyati ।
m: मम gen. sg. of 1st pers. pron. in comp.
a: मम — (Gen. sing. of अस्मद् the first personal pronoun) My, mine. --Comp. --कारः, --कृत्यं interesting oneself about anything, self-interest.

m: मम—कार m. interesting one's self about anything, Rājat.
ममक mfn. my, mine, RV. i, 31, 11; 34, 6 (cf. Pāṇ. iv, 3, 3 and मामक).
मम—कृत्य n. id., Vajras.
मम—सत्य n. ‘the being mine’, contest for ownership, RV. x, 42, 4.
ममत् ind. (repeated with चन or चिद्) no sooner—than &c., RV. iv, 18, 8; 9.

s: strI, (mama + BAve tal । wAp .) darpaH । aBimAnaH । iti hemacandraH । 2 । 231 ॥ mamatvam । yaTA, -- “taTApi mamatAvartte mohagartte nipAtitAH ॥” iti devImAhAtmyam ॥ (utaTyapatnI । sA tu dIrGatamomAtA । yaTA, fgvede । 6 । 10 । 2 । “stomaM yamasmE mamateva SUzaM GftaM na Suci matayaH pavante ॥” “mamatA nAma brahmavAdinI dIrGatamaso mAtA .” iti tadBAzye sAyaNaH ॥)
v: strI mama BAvaH tal । 1 darpe 2 ahaNkAre hema॰ । 3 matsambanDe ca । evaM mamatvamapyatra । “taTApi mamatAvartte” iti “mamatvaM mama rAjyasya” iti ca devImA॰ ।
m: मम—ता (मम-), f. the state of ‘mine’, sense of ownership, self-interest, egotism, interest in (loc.), MBh.; Kāv.; Pur.
pride, arrogance, L.
N. of the wife of Utathya and mother of Dīrgha-tamas, RV. vi, 10, 2 (Sāy.), MBh.; BhP.
a: ममता — [मम भावः तल्] 1 The feeling of ‘meum’, the sense of ownership, self-interest, selfishness. --2 Pride, arrogance, self-sufficiency. --3 Individuality.

m: मम—ता—शून्य mfn. devoid of interest for us, Prab.

s: puM, (mamatayA yuktaH .) kfpaRaH । iti SabdamAlA ॥ aBimAnAdiviSizwe, tri ॥
m: मम—ता—युक्त mfn. filled with selfishness, a miser or egotist (= कृपण), L.
ममत्तर mfn. = बलवत्-तर, MBh. (Nīlak.)

s: klI, (mama + BAve tva .) madIyatvam । yaTA, mArkaRqeyapurARe । “duHKAyatanaBUto hi mamatvAlambano gfhI ॥” snehaH । yaTA, -- “so'cintattadA tatra mamatvAkfzwacetanaH .” iti devImAhAtmyaMm ॥ “mamatvena srehena AkfzwA cetanA matiryasya । mameti zazWyantarUpamavyayaM tasya BAvaH mamatvam ॥” iti tawwIkAyAM kASIrAmaH ॥
m: मम—त्व n. = -ता, MBh.; Kāv. &c. (-त्वं √ 1. कृ P. -करोति, to be attached to, with loc. MBh.; to envy, with gen. MārkP.)
a: ममत्वं — 1 Regarding as ‘mine’ or one's own, sense of ownership. --2 Affectionate regard, attachment to, regard for; क्षुद्रेऽपि नूनं शरणं प्रपन्ने ममत्वमुच्चःशिरसां सतीव Ku. 1. 12. --3 Arrogance, pride.

m: मम्ब् cl. 1. P. मम्बति, to go, move, Dhātup. xi, 35 (Vop.)
मम्म m. N. of a man, Rājat.
(with भट्ट), N. of an author, Cat.
मम्मक m. N. of a man, Rājat.
मम्म—स्वामिन् m. N. of a temple built by Mamma, Rājat.
मम्मट m. (for महिम-भट्ट) N. of various writers (esp. of the author of the Kāvya-prakāśa), Cat.
a: मम्मटः — N. of the author of the Kāvyaprakāśa.
मम्मट — N. of the author of the Kāvyaprakāśa. He must have flourished before 1294 A. D. in which year a commentary on that work by name Jayantī was written by one Jayanta.

m: मम्रि mfn. mortal (see अ-मम्रि).
